branch_draw.procedure: randrange(10000), cumulative integer intervals preserving exact percentages

novelty_filter.method: recent repository commit scan plus direct reads of materially overlapping spawn reports
novelty_filter.limitation: GitHub content search did not enumerate SPAWN_RECEIPT files directly; novelty filtering therefore used the recent commit stream plus fetched recent run reports.

candidate_microdirections.question: Can ClayCode build/package identity become deterministic under source-order and environment variation without semantic redesign?
Can typed resource ownership/lifetime survive FFI plus cancellation without widening ClayCode semantics?
What is the smallest typed-host adapter contract needed for APP-02 without a semantic escape hatch?

Can APP-06 and later compiler self-hosting use a staged seed->compiler->Clay tool->partial/full self-host path with reproducibility receipts, avoiding premature self-host scope and new language semantics?

microdirection_draw.procedure: SystemRandom.choice over the eligible candidate list after duplicate filtering
microdirection_draw.note: No synthetic seed was invented; OS random state is intentionally not recoverable.

random_selection_evidence_rule: Selection probability is provenance only and does not increase evidence weight.
